# 消防接处警 GIS 控制-接口映射表（核心精简版）

**版本**：2.0（匹配 GIS 控制架构 v6.0）  
**更新日期**：2026-06-24  
**用途**：前后端接口定义、Mock 数据设计、联调对照、事件总线(EventBus)路由注册

---

## 映射总表（全量业务控制）

| 阶段 | 控制ID | 控制名称 | 类型 | EventKey（接口名） | 核心输入字段（Input） | 核心输出字段（Output） | 备注/状态 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **全局** | `GC-01` | 资源图层配置 | 内部配置 | 内部加载 | - | `layers: {id, visible}[]` | 系统启动加载 |
| **全局** | `GC-02` | 基础参数配置 | 内部配置 | 内部加载 | - | `defaultCenter, defaultZoom` | - |
| **全局** | `GC-03` | 清除策略配置 | 内部配置 | 内部加载 | - | `clearOnCaseClose, keepHistoryCount` | - |
| **画像** | `Profile`| 警情事件画像数据同步 | 全局监听 | `alarm.profile.sync` | `eventId, baseInfo, lifecycleStatus, spatialContext, dispatchPlan` | - | **核心：单一事实来源，触发其他联动** |
| **值守** | `EC-01` | 图层显隐与 WMS 刷新 | 外部控制 | `layer.set.visible` / `layer.refresh` | `layerId, visible, timestamp` | - | 透传至 G-V02 |
| **值守** | `EC-02` | 辖区基础 POI 定位控制 | 外部控制 | `poi.query` | `lngLat, radius, poiTypes, limit, showIcon` | - | 底层组合 G-S01+G-G01 |
| **值守** | `EC-03` | 围栏集合 AOI 定位控制 | 外部控制 | `aoi.highlight` | `alarmId, aoiList, fitBounds, strokeColor` | - | 底层组合 G-V01+G-G02 |
| **来电** | `EC-04` | 来电初略定位 | 外部控制 | `map.locate` | `lngLat, zoom, radius` | - | 底层组合 G-V01+G-G01 |
| **接警** | `EC-05` | 警情精确上图控制 | 外部控制 | `alarm.update` | `alarmId, lngLat, address, aoiList, fitBounds` | - | 监听画像变更触发 |
| **接警** | `EC-06` | 缩圈高亮周边资源控制 | 内部/外部 | `resource.query` | `geometry, resourceTypes, size` | `queryId, total, resources` | 监听画像 bufferRadius 触发 |
| **研判** | `EC-07` | 处警路径规划控制 | 外部控制 | `route.plan.request` | `requestId, start, end, strategy` | - | 底层组合 G-S03+G-G02 |
| **调度** | `EC-08` | 调派方案初始化控制 | 外部控制 | `dispatch.init` | `requestId, alarmInfo, standbyVehicles` | - | 批量落图 |
| **调度** | `EC-09` | 车辆状态微调控制 | 外部控制 | `dispatch.vehicle.add` / `remove` | `requestId, vehicle / vehicleId` | - | 监听画像 dispatchPlan 触发 |
| **执行** | `EC-10` | 车辆实时位置更新与轨迹 | 外部控制 | `dispatch.vehicle.move` | `vehicleId, lonlat, timestamp, speed` | - | 底层平滑移动+轨迹追加 |
| **BIM** | `EC-11` | BIM 场景初始化与白模 | 外部控制 | `bim.scene.init` | `incidentId, buildingId, centerLngLat, layers` | - | 研判阶段触发 |
| **BIM** | `EC-12` | 灾情业务参数动态更新 | 外部控制 | `bim.disaster.update` | `incidentId, fireFloors, trappedCount, smokeStatus` | - | 动态刷新 BIM 特效 |
| **BIM** | `EC-13` | BIM 场景人机交互控制 | 纯前端 | `bim.view.interact` | `actionType, currentPitch, currentBearing` | - | 前端本地操作 |
| **输出** | `OC-01` | 视图变更通知 | 输出控制 | `map.view.changed` | - | `center, zoom, bounds` | - |
| **输出** | `OC-02` | 业务拾取通知 | 输出控制 | `map.click` / `dispatch.vehicle.pick` | - | `pickId, vehicle / featureId, lngLat` | - |
| **输出** | `OC-03` | 规划结果抛出 | 输出控制 | `route.plan.result` | - | `requestId, path, distance, duration` | 响应 EC-07 |

---

## 简版 JSON Schema（核心业务对象与事件）

```json
{
  "definitions": {
    "LngLat": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "number" }, "minItems": 2, "maxItems": 2 },
    "GeometryPolygon": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "type": { "enum": ["Polygon"] },
        "coordinates": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "number" } } } }
      }
    },
    "AoiItem": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "id": { "type": "string" },
        "name": { "type": "string" },
        "geometry": { "$ref": "#/definitions/GeometryPolygon" }
      }
    },
    "Vehicle": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "id": { "type": "string" },
        "plateNo": { "type": "string" },
        "lonlat": { "$ref": "#/definitions/LngLat" },
        "carType": { "type": "string" },
        "status": { "type": "string", "enum": ["available", "dispatched", "responding", "on_scene"] }
      }
    },
    "AlarmInfo": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "警情基础对象",
      "properties": {
        "eventId": { "type": "string" },
        "disaster_address": { "type": "string", "description": "灾害地址" },
        "longitude": { "type": "number", "description": "经度" },
        "latitude": { "type": "number", "description": "纬度" },
        "disaster_type": { "type": "string", "description": "灾害类型" },
        "disaster_type_lv2": { "type": "string", "description": "灾害细类" },
        "disaster_des": { "type": "string", "description": "灾害描述" },
        "is_trapped": { "type": "string", "description": "是否有人员被困" },
        "trapped_position": { "type": "string", "description": "被困人员位置" },
        "trapped_num": { "type": "number", "description": "被困人员数量" },
        "is_casualty": { "type": "string", "description": "是否有人员伤亡" }
      }
    }
  },
  "events": {
    "alarm.profile.sync": {
      "description": "全局警情事件画像数据同步",
      "input": { "eventId": "string", "baseInfo": "object", "lifecycleStatus": "string", "spatialContext": "object", "dispatchPlan": "object" }
    },
    "map.locate": {
      "input": { "lngLat": "#/definitions/LngLat", "zoom": "number", "radius": "number" }
    },
    "alarm.update": {
      "input": { "alarmId": "string", "lngLat": "#/definitions/LngLat", "address": "string", "aoiList": "#/definitions/AoiItem[]", "fitBounds": "boolean" }
    },
    "resource.query": {
      "input": { "geometry": "#/definitions/GeometryPolygon", "resourceTypes": "string[]", "size": "number" },
      "output": { "queryId": "string", "total": "number", "resources": "array" }
    },
    "route.plan.request": {
      "input": { "requestId": "string", "start": { "id": "string", "lngLat": "#/definitions/LngLat" }, "end": { "lngLat": "#/definitions/LngLat" }, "strategy": "string" }
    },
    "route.plan.result": {
      "output": { "requestId": "string", "path": "array", "distance": "number", "duration": "number" }
    },
    "dispatch.init": {
      "input": { "requestId": "string", "alarmInfo": "#/definitions/AlarmInfo", "standbyVehicles": "#/definitions/Vehicle[]" }
    },
    "dispatch.vehicle.add": {
      "input": { "requestId": "string", "vehicle": "#/definitions/Vehicle" }
    },
    "dispatch.vehicle.remove": {
      "input": { "requestId": "string", "vehicleId": "string" }
    },
    "dispatch.vehicle.move": {
      "input": { "vehicleId": "string", "lonlat": "#/definitions/LngLat", "timestamp": "number", "speed": "number", "direction": "number" }
    },
    "aoi.highlight": {
      "input": { "alarmId": "string", "aoiList": "#/definitions/AoiItem[]", "fitBounds": "boolean", "strokeColor": "string" }
    },
    "poi.query": {
      "input": { "lngLat": "#/definitions/LngLat", "radius": "number", "poiTypes": "string[]", "limit": "number", "showIcon": "boolean" }
    },
    "layer.set.visible": {
      "input": { "layerId": "string", "visible": "boolean" }
    },
    "layer.refresh": {
      "input": { "layerId": "string", "timestamp": "number" }
    },
    "bim.scene.init": {
      "input": { "incidentId": "string", "buildingId": "string", "centerLngLat": "#/definitions/LngLat", "layers": "string[]" }
    },
    "bim.disaster.update": {
      "input": { "incidentId": "string", "fireFloors": "number[]", "trappedCount": "number", "smokeStatus": "object" }
    },
    "map.view.changed": {
      "output": { "center": "#/definitions/LngLat", "zoom": "number", "bounds": "object" }
    },
    "map.click": {
      "output": { "lngLat": "#/definitions/LngLat", "pixel": "object", "featureId": "string" }
    },
    "dispatch.vehicle.pick": {
      "output": { "pickId": "string", "vehicle": "#/definitions/Vehicle" }
    }
  }
}
```
